value.rationale: The central question measures when independently interpreted primitive positive modalities accidentally satisfy a classical complementary-scope semantic relation. An exact weighted-upset enumerator provides a natural finite invariant, a rigorous \(-2\) exponential rarity exponent for nonempty neighbourhoods, and a sharp positive limiting mass when the empty neighbourhood is allowed. It exposes a meaningful modelling boundary without claiming a general theorem for all modal arities.
